analysis.summary: Gandhar Oil Refinery reported its highest ever quarterly revenue for the second consecutive quarter in Q2 FY27, driven by strong performance in the Process and Insulating Oil (PIO) segment and robust gross margin spreads. Operations at the Silvassa unit were temporarily disrupted by heavy rainfall and flooding in July, resulting in an exceptional inventory loss item of approximately INR21 crores. Management highlighted ongoing challenges from West Asian geopolitical tensions and shipping disruptions affecting raw material availability and export volumes, particularly at their UAE subsidiary Texol. The company remains focused on disciplined sourcing, expanding capacity through capitalized CWIP, and maintaining a strong net cash position. Gandhar Oil Refinery reported its highest-ever quarterly performance for Q2 FY27, achieving a revenue of ₹1,847 crore and a profit after tax of ₹186 crore.

guidance.claim: The company expects volume growth in the range of 8% to 11% for the year.
guidance.quote: Historically, we've always been doing volume growth in the range of 8% to 10% to even 11%. So, we see ourselves getting that much of volume growth during this year also.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that export revenue and sales will remain at similar levels in the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: We anticipate the export revenue and the export sales will be in the same level for the quarters to come.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates that margins will continue at stellar levels for at least the next one or two quarters.
guidance.quote: So obviously, this has been a historical good quarter. But obviously, we anticipate the margins would be continued to be at a stellar levels for at least the next 1 or 2 quarters to come.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from the healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors remained steady during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: However, demand from the health care and pharmaceutical sectors remained steady.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in the PIO segment was driven by healthy demand from transformers, power, and the rubber industry.
demand_outlook.quote: The growth was driven by healthy demand from the transformers, power and the rubber industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Management sees encouraging long-term growth opportunities for the PIO segment due to increasing electricity demand and power infrastructure investments.
demand_outlook.quote: With increasing electricity demand and continued investment in the power infrastructure in India and globally, we see encouraging long-term growth opportunity for this segment.

demand_outlook.claim: The underlying demand environment remains encouraging despite global macroeconomic and geopolitical developments.
demand_outlook.quote: While we remain watchful of global macroeconomic and geopolitical developments, the underlying demand environment remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Robust increase in demand from the power sector is contributed by addition of data centers and increment in power requirements across the country.
demand_outlook.quote: See, there has been a robust increase in the demand from the power sector contributed by addition of data centers, increment of the power requirement across the country.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed strong traction in process and insulating oils, with half-yearly volumes increasing by 23% year-on-year driven by demand from the transformer, power, and rubber industries.
demand_outlook.quote: We continued to see strong traction in PIO, with half yearly volumes growing 23% year-on-year, supported by demand from the transformer, power and rubber industries.

demand_outlook.claim: Lubricants volumes showed sequential improvement during the period.
demand_outlook.quote: Lubricants volumes improved sequentially, while in PHPO, we remain focused on addressing changing customer requirements and competitive dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the performance was driven by a healthy demand environment across key end-user industries.
demand_outlook.quote: Our performance during this quarter was driven by a healthy demand environment across our key end-user industries, coupled with disciplined execution across the businesses.

demand_outlook.claim: The PIO business grew 28% year-on-year supported by healthy demand from transformer, power, and rubber manufacturers.
demand_outlook.quote: Our PIO business also delivered a robust performance, growing 28% year-on-year, supported by healthy demand from the transformer, power and the rubber manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: Transformer oil demand is expected to have strong and robust growth due to increasing electricity requirements globally and in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Thanks to the increasing requirement of electricity, not only in India, but globally; we anticipate even our transformer oil that is the PIO category to have a strong and robust growth for the future and the quarters to come.

capex_expansion.claim: Consolidated installed capacity stands at 838,637 kiloliters following the capitalization of capital WIP over recent quarters.
capex_expansion.quote: Our installed capacity on a consolidated basis now stands at 838,637 kiloliters.

capex_expansion.claim: Installed capacity for Indian plants stands at 602,713 kiloliters, while Texol's capacity remains unchanged at 235,924 kiloliters.
capex_expansion.quote: Having enumerated the same, our installed capacity for the Indian plants now stood at 602,713. As the installed capacity remains unchanged of Texol of 2,35,924, the total installed capacity now stands at 838,000 which is an enhancement of 240,000 over the existing capacity of 5,98,000, which is basically on account of the capitalization over the last few quarters of the capital WIP.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity enhancements were achieved through debottlenecking, IPO proceeds, and internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: So, apart from debottlenecking, there were investments which were done from the IPO proceeds and also from some internal accruals, for which Mr. Indrajit has informed, it has been transferred from CWIP to the fixed assets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed a debottlenecking programme during the quarter to strengthen operating capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: We also completed a debottlenecking programme during the quarter, strengthening our operating capacity.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for the quarter stood at INR388 crores with a gross margin of 21%.
margins_costs.quote: The gross profit stood at INR388 crores compared with INR130 crores in Q2 FY '26 with a gross margin of 21%.

margins_costs.claim: The gross margin spread was approximately INR29,128 per kl compared with INR9,000 per kl in Q2 FY '26.
margins_costs.quote: The gross margin spread was approximately INR29,128 per kl compared with INR9,000 per kl in Q2 FY '26 and INR28,000 per kl in Q1 FY '27.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR288 crores, representing 15.6% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR288 crores compared with INR66 crores in Q2 FY '26, a growth of approximately 337% year-on-year. EBITDA was 15.6% compared with 6.2% in Q2 FY '26.

margins_costs.claim: An ex gratia of INR15 crores to INR16 crores was paid across the board to everybody, impacting employee expenses.
margins_costs.quote: There is a INR15 crores -- INR16 crores ex gratia which has been paid across the board to everybody.

margins_costs.claim: The flooding at Silvassa resulted in an inventory loss and exceptional item of approximately INR21 crores.
margins_costs.quote: The flooding at Silvassa resulted in an inventory loss of approximately INR21 crores. As this is a onetime event, we have presented it as an exceptional item.

margins_costs.claim: War risk insurance rates have gone up for vessels coming out of the Hormuz.
margins_costs.quote: So, we have not seen so much but only the war risk premium has been added from especially the vessels coming out of the Hormuz.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin spread was sustained at ₹29,128 per kl, which is 3.0x year-on-year and in line with Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin Spread sustained at ₹29,128 per kl, 3.0x year-on-year and in line with Q1 FY27

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin spreads expanded to INR 28,145 per kilolitre compared to quarter 1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, the consolidated revenue increased by 92% year-on-year to INR 1,731.9 crores, while the gross margin spread expanded to 3.4x Y-o-Y basis to INR 28,145 per kilolitre compared to quarter 1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins expanded to 16.20% compared with 5.1% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 16.20% compared with 5.1% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: The gross margin for the quarter on a consolidated level was 21.4%.
Management stated that the company does not carry large inventories to justify inventory gains or losses, carrying raw material up to 30 to 40 days.
margins_costs.quote: We don't carry that much of inventory to justify inventory gains or inventory losses. On the raw material front, we carry inventories generally up to 30, 35, 40 days. So not much of this is represented by inventory gains at the inventory level.

orders_capacity.claim: H1 volume for the Process and Insulating Oil (PIO) segment grew 23% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: This business continued to deliver a very strong performance with H1 volume growing 23% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Lubricant business volume remained broadly stable year-on-year and improved by approximately 9% sequentially compared to the previous quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: In our lubricant business, volume remained broadly stable year-on-year, while improving by approximately 9% sequentially compared with our previous quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization on a stand-alone level is 82% to be precise.
orders_capacity.quote: So, I can tell you currently, currently the utilization on stand-alone level is 80%, 82% to be precise.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the consolidated level is around 61%.
orders_capacity.quote: The consol level, it is around 61%.

orders_capacity.claim: Stand-alone volume growth registered is more than 15%, roughly around 16% from H1 last year to H1 current year.
orders_capacity.quote: if you look at the sales volume, we have grown at a volume of around 16% on stand-alone basis year-on-year, H1 last year and H1 current year.

orders_capacity.claim: CRISIL reaffirmed A+/Stable and A1 ratings and rated bank facilities to ₹1,014 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: CRISIL reaffirmed A+/Stable and A1 ratings; rated bank facilities to ₹1,014 crore

orders_capacity.claim: Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared with approximately 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Total sales volume during the quarter stood at approximately 131,000 kilolitres compared with approximately 121,000 kilolitres in Q1 FY26, reflecting a growth of around 8% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Production capacity across all 3 plants taken together is utilized at around 97% on a 2-shift basis.
orders_capacity.quote: On a company level, all 3 plants taken together, it's around 97%.

capital_allocation.claim: The stand-alone company remains debt-free as of date.
capital_allocation.quote: The stand-alone company remains debt-free as of date.

capital_allocation.claim: Consolidated borrowings reduced to about INR85 crores as on September 30, 2026, down from INR168 crores in March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Consolidated borrowings which relate mainly to trade finance and borrowings at our overseas Texol level reduced to about INR85 crores as on 30th September '26 from INR168 crores in March '26.

capital_allocation.claim: Total equity increased to INR1,771 crores from INR1,400 crores in March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Total equity increased to INR1,771 crores from INR1,400 crores in March '26.

capital_allocation.claim: Rated bank facilities were enhanced to INR1,014 crores and CRISIL reaffirmed long-term rating at A+/Stable and short-term rating at A1.
capital_allocation.quote: At the same time, our rated bank facilities were enhanced to INR1,014 crores. This reflects the confidence of our lending partners and give us headroom to support the larger scale of our procurement and businesses.

capital_allocation.claim: The company declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of the shares.
capital_allocation.quote: We are also glad to inform that we have declared an interim dividend of 100% of the face value of our share.

capital_allocation.claim: The standalone company Gandhar Oil is effectively debt-free.
capital_allocation.quote: We remain effectively debt-free, while consolidated borrowings primarily relate to normal trade finance arrangements and borrowings at our overseas subsidiary, Texol.

capital_allocation.claim: The company decided to use about INR 20 crores of the quarter's performance for the payment of the interim dividend.
capital_allocation.quote: Currently, we have decided to use about INR20 crores of this for payment of interim dividend.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operating environment remains challenging with ongoing tensions in West Asia and disruptions to global shipping routes.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment during this quarter continues to remain challenging with ongoing tensions in the West Asia and disruptions to the global shipping routes.

risks_headwinds.claim: Base oil availability and prices remain uncertain, and freight and insurance costs continue to affect supply chain planning.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our key raw material base oil availability and prices remain uncertain and freight and insurance costs continue to affect supply chain planning.

risks_headwinds.claim: PHPO volumes declined slightly in the second quarter due to slower offtake from certain key Personal Care customers facing competition from newer and smaller brands.
risks_headwinds.quote: This was primarily due to the slower offtake from certain key Personal Care customers who are facing increased competition from the newer and smaller brands.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export volumes moderated during the quarter primarily due to geopolitical developments in West Asia and impacts on shipping and logistics.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, export volume had moderated during this quarter, primarily due to the geopolitical developments in West Asia and the impact on the shipping and logistics.

risks_headwinds.claim: Silvassa unit 2 was affected by heavy rainfall and a flood-like situation in July.
risks_headwinds.quote: As shared earlier, our Silvassa unit 2 was affected by a heavy rainfall and a flood-like situation in July this year.

risks_headwinds.claim: There continues to be a gap between the demand and supply of base oil because of refinery closures and vessel disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Obviously, there is a supply gap because of refinery closures because of vessel disruption. So, there continues to be a gap between the demand and the supply.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical developments in West Asia presented operational challenges during the quarter, impacting base oil availability, pricing, and shipping logistics.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter presented operational challenges, particularly due to geopolitical developments in West Asia, which impacted base oil availability, pricing and shipping logistics.

risks_headwinds.claim: Heavy rainfall and flooding caused disruption at the Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July, though operations were restored in early August.
risks_headwinds.quote: Following the disruption caused by heavy rainfall and flooding at our Silvassa Unit No. 2 in July, we restored operations in early August through the focused efforts of our teams.

risks_headwinds.claim: Operations at subsidiary Texol were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and vessel movement disruptions from geopolitical situations in the Middle East.
risks_headwinds.quote: During this period -- during the period of quarter 1, operations were temporarily impacted by regional supply constraints and disruption in vessel movements arising from the geopolitical situation.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operating environment was challenged by geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, Strait of Hormuz concerns, and crude and base oil pricing volatility.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operating environment remained challenging, shaped by heightened geopolitical tension in the Middle East, concerns surrounding the Strait of Hormuz, volatility in the crude oil and the base oil pricing and intermittent disruptions across the global supply chains.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains focused on strengthening customer relationships and addressing evolving market dynamics in the PHPO segment.
management_commitments.quote: The PHPO continues to be our largest and the most important product category, and we remain focused on strengthening our customer relationships and addressing evolving market dynamics.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains focused on serving international customers and capturing long-term growth opportunities despite near-term challenges.
management_commitments.quote: While the near-term condition remains challenging, exports continue to be an important part of the business, and we remain focused on serving our international customers and capturing long-term growth opportunities.

management_commitments.claim: Texol unit focus remains on ensuring operational efficiency, maintaining reliable customer service, and minimizing external disruption impacts.
management_commitments.quote: Our focus remains on ensuring operational efficiency, maintaining reliable customer service and managing and minimizing the impact of external disruption.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated clear priorities to deepen presence across segments, expand into new geographies, move into higher value chain, and expand capacity.
management_commitments.quote: Moving ahead, our priorities remain clear: deepen our presence across segments, expand into new geographies, move into higher value chain and expand capacity.

management_commitments.claim: Capital allocation priorities remain focused on funding growth capex largely through internal accruals and maintaining a prudent balance sheet.
management_commitments.quote: Our priorities remain focused on funding growth CapEx largely through internal accruals, maintaining a prudent balance sheet and creating sustainable long-term value for our shareholders.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a continued focus on improving operational efficiency, deepening customer engagement, expanding geographic presence, and progressing capacity-expansion plans.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we will continue to focus on improving operational efficiency, deepening customer engagement, expanding our presence across geographies and progressing our capacity-expansion plans.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company will continue to focus on the PHPO product category and the process and insulating oil category.
management_commitments.quote: So obviously, the company will continue to focus on specifically PHPO product and obviously, the process and insulating oil category.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
